title: Pink Floyd - Side 4, pt. 4: Louder Than Words (from The Endless River)

lines.l: We pitch and we fight, diss each other on sight.
But this thing we do, these times again, rain or shine,
the stormy weather, this thing we do.
We could curse it or nurse it and give it a name
Or stay home by the fire
But we're here for the right
It's a thousand words, this family drew
A thousand words, the way on the surface
And as the hours glide by
It's a thousand words, it's dream and true
And I'm the words, the way of the stars
It's louder than words, the sum of our parts
The beat of our hearts, it's louder than words
Louder than words, this thing they consume
It's there with a pulse, louder than words
